Devotion +84: Passive: +84 Equipment bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Insightful Impulse +42: Passive: +42 Insight bonus to Force, Untyped, Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning Spell Power.
Insightful Devotion +42: Passive: +42 Insight bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
